Interface Keyboard

All Known Implementing Classes:
NativeKeyboard
public interface Keyboard
A keyboard polled by the board program. Call update() in the main loop, then inspect the current keys when isChanged() reports a transition. Key values are Unicode/ASCII character codes plus the control constants declared here.
